scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local keySources = {
	{ "ChaseWorld", "KeySpawns" },
	{ "ChaseSpots", "KeySpawns" },
}

local monsterList = {
	{
		Name = "ELI",
		Path = { "ChaseWorld", "Eli" },
		AnchorParts = { "Eli_Torso", "Eli_Head" },
		StateAttribute = "EliState",
		ChaseStates = { CHASE = true, HUNT = true, STALK = true, KILL = true },
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
	},
	{
		Name = "TWIN",
		Path = { "TwinEntity" },
		AnchorParts = { "Root" },
		StateAttribute = "State",
		ChaseStates = { chase = true, hunt = true, kill = true },
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 200),
	},
	{
		Name = "SCROW",
		Path = { "Scrow" },
		AnchorParts = { "Root" },
		StateAttribute = "State",
		ChaseStates = { chase = true, hunt = true },
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 120, 255),
	},
}

local monitorDistance = 60
local minActiveHeight = -50
local maxDrawDistance = 3000
local keyColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)
local keyLabelColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 90)
local arrowGlyph = "\226\158\156"

local keyModels = {}
local monsterModels = {}
local connections = {}
local espOn = true
local unloaded = false

local function walkPath(root, path)
	local node = root
	for _, segment in ipairs(path) do
		if node == nil then
			return nil
		end
		node = node:FindFirstChild(segment)
	end
	return node
end

local function getKeyPosition(model)
	local point = model:FindFirstChild("KeyPoint", true)
	if point and point:IsA("Attachment") then
		return point.WorldPosition
	end

	local mesh = model:FindFirstChild("KEY__key")
	if mesh and mesh:IsA("BasePart") then
		return mesh.Position
	end

	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			return d.Position
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function getMonsterPosition(model, anchorParts)
	for _, partName in ipairs(anchorParts) do
		local part = model:FindFirstChild(partName, true)
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			return part.Position
		end
	end

	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Transparency < 1 then
			return d.Position
		end
	end

	local root = model:FindFirstChild("RootPart") or model:FindFirstChild("Root")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return root.Position
	end

	return nil
end

local function distanceFromPlayer(position)
	if position == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local character = localPlayer.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		return (root.Position - position).Magnitude
	end

	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		return (camera.CFrame.Position - position).Magnitude
	end

	return nil
end

local function readState(model, spec)
	if not spec.StateAttribute then
		return nil
	end

	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return model:GetAttribute(spec.StateAttribute)
	end)

	if ok and value ~= nil then
		return tostring(value)
	end

	return nil
end

local function isChasingState(state, spec)
	if not state then
		return false
	end

	local upper = string.upper(state)
	for chaseState in pairs(spec.ChaseStates) do
		if upper == string.upper(chaseState) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

local function buildArrow(color)
	local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	arrow.Name = "espArrow"
	arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64)
	arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	arrow.TextSize = 46
	arrow.TextColor3 = color
	arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	arrow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	arrow.Text = arrowGlyph
	arrow.Visible = false
	arrow.Parent = playerGui
	return arrow
end

local function updateArrow(arrow, position, color)
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end

	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	if viewport.X <= 0 or viewport.Y <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local screenPoint, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)

	if onScreen and screenPoint.Z > 0 then
		local clampedX = math.clamp(screenPoint.X, 48, viewport.X - 48)
		local clampedY = math.clamp(screenPoint.Y, 48, viewport.Y - 48)

		if clampedX == screenPoint.X and clampedY == screenPoint.Y then
			arrow.Visible = false
			return
		end

		arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(clampedX, clampedY)
	else
		local relative = camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		local flat = Vector2.new(relative.X, relative.Y)

		if flat.Magnitude < 1e-4 then
			flat = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		else
			flat = flat.Unit
		end

		if relative.Z > 0 then
			flat = -flat
		end

		local halfX = viewport.X / 2
		local halfY = viewport.Y / 2
		local scale = math.min(
			halfX / math.max(math.abs(flat.X), 1e-4),
			halfY / math.max(math.abs(flat.Y), 1e-4)
		)

		local projectedX = halfX + flat.X * scale
		local projectedY = halfY - flat.Y * scale

		arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
			math.clamp(projectedX, 48, viewport.X - 48),
			math.clamp(projectedY, 48, viewport.Y - 48)
		)
	end

	arrow.TextColor3 = color
	arrow.Visible = true
end

local function buildKeyEsp(model)
	if getKeyPosition(model) == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.Name = "keyEspHighlight"
	highlight.Adornee = model
	highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	highlight.FillColor = keyColor
	highlight.FillTransparency = 0.65
	highlight.OutlineColor = keyColor
	highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
	highlight.Parent = model

	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "keyEspLabel"
	gui.Adornee = model
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 22)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)
	gui.MaxDistance = maxDrawDistance
	gui.Parent = model

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Text"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextSize = 14
	label.TextColor3 = keyLabelColor
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	label.Text = "KEY"
	label.Parent = gui

	return {
		Model = model,
		Highlight = highlight,
		Gui = gui,
		Label = label,
		Arrow = buildArrow(keyColor),
	}
end

local function buildMonsterEsp(model, spec)
	if getMonsterPosition(model, spec.AnchorParts) == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.Name = "monsterEspHighlight"
	highlight.Adornee = model
	highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	highlight.FillColor = spec.Color
	highlight.FillTransparency = 0.85
	highlight.OutlineColor = spec.Color
	highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
	highlight.Parent = model

	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "monsterEspLabel"
	gui.Adornee = model
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 40)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0)
	gui.MaxDistance = maxDrawDistance
	gui.Parent = model

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.6, 0)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	title.TextSize = 17
	title.TextColor3 = spec.Color
	title.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	title.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	title.Text = spec.Name
	title.Parent = gui

	local subtitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	subtitle.Name = "Subtitle"
	subtitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	subtitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.58, 0)
	subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.42, 0)
	subtitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	subtitle.TextSize = 13
	subtitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 235)
	subtitle.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	subtitle.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	subtitle.Text = ""
	subtitle.Parent = gui

	return {
		Model = model,
		Spec = spec,
		Highlight = highlight,
		Gui = gui,
		Title = title,
		Subtitle = subtitle,
		Arrow = buildArrow(spec.Color),
	}
end

local function destroyEntry(entry)
	for _, inst in ipairs({ entry.Highlight, entry.Gui, entry.Arrow }) do
		if inst then
			inst:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function collectKeys()
	local found = {}

	for _, source in ipairs(keySources) do
		local container = walkPath(Workspace, source)
		if container then
			for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				local key = child:FindFirstChild("Key")
				if key and key:IsA("Model") then
					table.insert(found, key)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return found
end

local function collectMonsters()
	local found = {}

	for _, spec in ipairs(monsterList) do
		local model = walkPath(Workspace, spec.Path)
		if model and model.Parent then
			local position = getMonsterPosition(model, spec.AnchorParts)
			if position and position.Y > minActiveHeight then
				table.insert(found, { Model = model, Spec = spec })
			end
		end
	end

	return found
end

local function syncEsp()
	if unloaded then
		return
	end

	local liveKeys = {}
	for _, model in ipairs(collectKeys()) do
		liveKeys[model] = true
		if not keyModels[model] then
			local ok, entry = pcall(buildKeyEsp, model)
			if ok and entry then
				keyModels[model] = entry
			end
		end
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		if not liveKeys[model] or not model.Parent then
			destroyEntry(entry)
			keyModels[model] = nil
		end
	end

	local liveMonsters = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(collectMonsters()) do
		liveMonsters[item.Model] = item.Spec
		if not monsterModels[item.Model] then
			local ok, entry = pcall(buildMonsterEsp, item.Model, item.Spec)
			if ok and entry then
				monsterModels[item.Model] = entry
			end
		end
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		if not liveMonsters[model] or not model.Parent then
			destroyEntry(entry)
			monsterModels[model] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function updateKeyEsp(entry)
	local position = getKeyPosition(entry.Model)
	if position == nil then
		return
	end

	local distance = distanceFromPlayer(position)
	if distance then
		entry.Label.Text = "KEY  " .. tostring(math.floor(distance + 0.5)) .. "m"
	end

	if entry.Arrow then
		updateArrow(entry.Arrow, position, keyColor)
	end
end

local function updateMonsterEsp(entry)
	local position = getMonsterPosition(entry.Model, entry.Spec.AnchorParts)
	if position == nil then
		return
	end

	local distance = distanceFromPlayer(position)
	local state = readState(entry.Model, entry.Spec)
	local chasing = isChasingState(state, entry.Spec)
	local close = distance ~= nil and distance <= monitorDistance

	local color = entry.Spec.Color
	if close then
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	elseif chasing then
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 0)
	end

	entry.Highlight.OutlineColor = color
	entry.Highlight.FillColor = color
	entry.Highlight.FillTransparency = close and 0.7 or 0.85
	entry.Title.TextColor3 = color
	entry.Title.Text = close and (entry.Spec.Name .. "  !!") or entry.Spec.Name

	local info = {}
	if state then
		table.insert(info, string.upper(state))
	end
	if distance then
		table.insert(info, tostring(math.floor(distance + 0.5)) .. "m")
	end
	if close then
		table.insert(info, "CLOSE")
	end
	entry.Subtitle.Text = table.concat(info, "  ")

	if entry.Arrow then
		updateArrow(entry.Arrow, position, color)
	end
end

local function setEspVisible(visible)
	espOn = visible

	for _, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		entry.Highlight.Enabled = visible
		entry.Gui.Enabled = visible
		if not visible and entry.Arrow then
			entry.Arrow.Visible = false
		end
	end

	for _, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		entry.Highlight.Enabled = visible
		entry.Gui.Enabled = visible
		if not visible and entry.Arrow then
			entry.Arrow.Visible = false
		end
	end
end

local function unloadEsp()
	if unloaded then
		return
	end

	unloaded = true
	espOn = false

	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)

	for model, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		destroyEntry(entry)
		keyModels[model] = nil
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		destroyEntry(entry)
		monsterModels[model] = nil
	end
end

table.insert(connections, Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
	task.defer(syncEsp)
end))

table.insert(connections, Workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function()
	task.defer(syncEsp)
end))

table.insert(connections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if unloaded then
		return
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		if model.Parent then
			pcall(updateKeyEsp, entry)
		else
			destroyEntry(entry)
			keyModels[model] = nil
		end
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		if model.Parent then
			pcall(updateMonsterEsp, entry)
		else
			destroyEntry(entry)
			monsterModels[model] = nil
		end
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed or unloaded then
		return
	end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
		setEspVisible(not espOn)
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
		unloadEsp()
	end
end))

task.spawn(function()
	while not unloaded do
		task.wait(0.75)
		pcall(syncEsp)
	end
end)

syncEsp()

scripts.script:
if getgenv().AutoPoopCleanup then
    pcall(getgenv().AutoPoopCleanup)
    getgenv().AutoPoopCleanup = nil
end

if getgenv().AutoPoopLibrary then
    pcall(function()
        getgenv().AutoPoopLibrary:Unload()
    end)
    getgenv().AutoPoopLibrary = nil
end

local libraryUrl = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/croksyscript/CrypticLoader/refs/heads/main/Obsidian/Obsidian_UI/Obsidian_UI.lua"

local success, Library = pcall(function()
    return loadstring(game:HttpGet(libraryUrl))()
end)

if not success or not Library then
    return
end

getgenv().AutoPoopLibrary = Library

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerScripts = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Packets = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packets"))
local minigameActive = PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("IS_MINIGAME_ACTIVE")

local okFood, FoodData = pcall(require, ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FoodData"))
local okMoney, FormatMoney = pcall(require, ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FormatMoney"))

local PoopUI = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("PoopUI")
local lineTrigger = PoopUI:WaitForChild("CatchBar"):WaitForChild("LineTrigger")
local slider = PoopUI.CatchBar:WaitForChild("BarLine"):WaitForChild("Slider")
local target = slider:WaitForChild("Target")

local BACKPACK_LIMIT = 300

local state = {
    running = true,
    notifications = {},
    remotePoop = false,
    legitPoop = false,
    instantLine = false,
    remoteDelay = 1,
    pause = 2,
    cycles = 0,
    autoSell = false,
    sellMode = "Poop Count",
    sellValue = 100,
    sellAction = "Sell All",
    sellOneMode = "First",
    lastSell = os.clock(),
    autoBuy = false,
    buyInterval = 10,
    selectedFoods = {},
    stock = {},
}

local connections = {}

local function jitter(minValue, maxValue)
    return minValue + math.random() * (maxValue - minValue)
end

local function formatMoney(value)
    if okMoney and typeof(value) == "number" then
        local ok, text = pcall(FormatMoney, value, true)
        if ok then
            return text
        end
    end
    return tostring(value)
end

local function isPoop(tool)
    return tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Name:sub(1, 4) == "Poop"
end

local function getPoops()
    local list = {}
    for _, tool in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if isPoop(tool) then
            table.insert(list, tool)
        end
    end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local held = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if held and isPoop(held) then
        table.insert(list, held)
    end
    return list
end

local function getBackpackSize()
    return #LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()
end

local function getWeight(tool)
    return tonumber(tool.Name:match("([%d%.]+)%s*lb")) or 0
end

local CLICK_LATENCY = 0.05

local lastCenter = 0
local lastTime = os.clock()

local function isLineInTarget()
    local now = os.clock()
    local center = lineTrigger.AbsolutePosition.X + lineTrigger.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    local elapsed = math.max(now - lastTime, 1 / 240)
    local velocity = (center - lastCenter) / elapsed
    lastCenter = center
    lastTime = now
    local predicted = center + velocity * CLICK_LATENCY
    local margin = lineTrigger.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.065
    local left = target.AbsolutePosition.X
    return left - margin < predicted and predicted < left + target.AbsoluteSize.X + margin
end

local function sendMouse(position, down)
    VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(position.X, position.Y, 0, down, game, 0)
end

local CLICK_SPOTS = {}

for _, x in ipairs({ 0.04, 0.96, 0.08, 0.92 }) do
    for _, y in ipairs({ 0.35, 0.5, 0.25, 0.65, 0.75 }) do
        table.insert(CLICK_SPOTS, Vector2.new(x, y))
    end
end

local function isSpotFree(point)
    local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
    for _, gui in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(point.X - inset.X, point.Y - inset.Y)) do
        if not gui:IsDescendantOf(PoopUI) and (gui:IsA("GuiButton") or gui.Active) then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

local function getFreePoint()
    local size = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
    for _, spot in ipairs(CLICK_SPOTS) do
        local point = size * spot
        if isSpotFree(point) then
            return point
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function clickTrigger()
    local position = getFreePoint()
    if not position then
        return
    end
    sendMouse(position, true)
    task.wait(0.03)
    sendMouse(position, false)
end

local function getChargeFill()
    local chargeUi = workspace:FindFirstChild("ChargeUI")
    local bar = chargeUi and chargeUi:FindFirstChild("BarProgress", true)
    return bar and bar:FindFirstChild("Fill")
end

local function chargeBar()
    local position = getFreePoint()
    if not position then
        task.wait(1)
        return
    end
    sendMouse(position, true)
    local startTime = os.clock()
    local fill
    repeat
        task.wait()
        fill = getChargeFill()
    until fill or os.clock() - startTime > 0.5
    while os.clock() - startTime < 2 do
        if fill and fill.Parent and fill.Size.Y.Scale >= 0.97 then
            break
        end
        if not fill and os.clock() - startTime >= 0.7 then
            break
        end
        task.wait()
    end
    sendMouse(position, false)
end

local targetAspect = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
local defaultAspectRatio = targetAspect and targetAspect.AspectRatio
local WIDE_ASPECT_RATIO = 4

local function moveTargetToLine()
    local lineCenter = lineTrigger.AbsolutePosition.X + lineTrigger.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    local targetCenter = target.AbsolutePosition.X + target.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    local position = slider.Position
    slider.Position = UDim2.new(position.X.Scale, position.X.Offset + lineCenter - targetCenter, position.Y.Scale, position.Y.Offset)
end

local function widenTarget()
    if targetAspect then
        targetAspect.AspectRatio = WIDE_ASPECT_RATIO
    end
end

local function restoreTarget()
    if targetAspect then
        targetAspect.AspectRatio = defaultAspectRatio
    end
end

local function runLegitCycle()
    if not minigameActive.Value then
        chargeBar()
        task.wait(0.3)
    end
    local deadline = os.clock() + 30
    while state.running and minigameActive.Value and os.clock() < deadline do
        if state.instantLine then
            widenTarget()
            moveTargetToLine()
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            moveTargetToLine()
            clickTrigger()
            task.wait(jitter(0.2, 0.3))
        elseif isLineInTarget() then
            clickTrigger()
            task.wait(jitter(0.4, 0.55))
        end
        task.wait()
    end
    restoreTarget()
    state.cycles += 1
    task.wait(state.pause * jitter(0.85, 1.25))
end

local function runRemoteCycle()
    Packets.RequestPoop:Fire()
    state.cycles += 1
    local delay = state.remoteDelay * jitter(0.8, 1.35)
    if math.random() < 0.05 then
        delay += jitter(2, 4)
    end
    task.wait(delay)
end

local function pickPoop(mode)
    local poops = getPoops()
    if #poops == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    if mode == "Held" then
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local held = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        return held and isPoop(held) and held or nil
    end
    if mode == "Smallest" or mode == "Biggest" then
        table.sort(poops, function(a, b)
            if mode == "Smallest" then
                return getWeight(a) < getWeight(b)
            end
            return getWeight(a) > getWeight(b)
        end)
    end
    return poops[1]
end

local function sellOne(mode)
    local tool = pickPoop(mode)
    local uuid = tool and tool:GetAttribute("uniquePoopID")
    if not uuid then
        return false
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return Packets.SellCurrentlyHeldPoop:Fire(uuid)
    end)
    if ok then
        Library:Notify("Sold poop for " .. formatMoney(result), 3)
    end
    return ok
end

local function sellAll()
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return Packets.SellInventory:Fire()
    end)
    if ok then
        state.lastSell = os.clock()
        Library:Notify("Sold inventory for " .. formatMoney(result), 3)
    end
    return ok
end

local function runSell()
    if state.sellAction == "Sell One" then
        return sellOne(state.sellOneMode == "Held" and "First" or state.sellOneMode)
    end
    return sellAll()
end

local function refreshStock()
    pcall(function()
        Packets.FoodStock:Fire()
    end)
end

local function buyFood(name)
    pcall(function()
        Packets.PurchaseFood:Fire(name)
    end)
end

local function getFoodNames()
    local names = {}
    if okFood and typeof(FoodData) == "table" then
        for name in pairs(FoodData) do
            table.insert(names, name)
        end
        table.sort(names, function(a, b)
            return FoodData[a].Price < FoodData[b].Price
        end)
    end
    return names
end

local function getStockText()
    local names = {}
    for name in pairs(state.stock) do
        table.insert(names, name)
    end
    table.sort(names)
    return #names > 0 and table.concat(names, ", ") or "Nothing"
end

table.insert(connections, Packets.FoodStock.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(list)
    state.stock = {}
    if typeof(list) == "table" then
        for _, name in ipairs(list) do
            state.stock[name] = true
        end
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, Packets.PurchaseFood.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(purchased, name)
    if purchased then
        state.stock[name] = nil
        table.insert(state.notifications, "Bought " .. tostring(name))
    end
end))

task.spawn(function()
    while state.running do
        local hasSpace = getBackpackSize() < BACKPACK_LIMIT
        local cycle = nil
        if hasSpace and state.remotePoop then
            cycle = runRemoteCycle
        elseif state.legitPoop and (hasSpace or minigameActive.Value) then
            cycle = runLegitCycle
        end
        if cycle then
            local ok = pcall(cycle)
            if not ok then
                task.wait(1)
            end
        else
            task.wait(0.3)
        end
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while state.running do
        if state.autoSell then
            if state.sellMode == "Seconds" then
                if os.clock() - state.lastSell >= state.sellValue then
                    state.lastSell = os.clock()
                    runSell()
                end
            elseif #getPoops() >= state.sellValue then
                runSell()
                task.wait(2)
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while state.running do
        local text = table.remove(state.notifications, 1)
        if text then
            Library:Notify(text, 3)
        end
        task.wait(0.3)
    end
end)

local lastBuyCheck = 0

task.spawn(function()
    while state.running do
        local due = os.clock() - lastBuyCheck >= state.buyInterval
        if state.autoBuy and due and next(state.selectedFoods) then
            lastBuyCheck = os.clock()
            refreshStock()
            task.wait(1)
            for name in pairs(state.selectedFoods) do
                if state.stock[name] then
                    buyFood(name)
                    task.wait(jitter(0.5, 0.9))
                end
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

local Window = Library:CreateWindow({
    Title = "Open Source - Poop a Big Poop",
    Footer = ".gg/XDpsSW7Ybs",
    Icon = 120217226033572,
    NotifySide = "Right",
    Center = true,
    AutoShow = true,
    ToggleKeybind = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
    Folder = "Poop",
})

local function buildPoopTab(Tab)
    local Box = Tab:AddGroupbox({
        Side = "Left",
        Name = "Auto Poop",
        IconName = "zap",
    })

    Box:AddToggle("RemotePoopToggle", {
        Text = "Auto Poop (Remote)",
        Default = false,
        Tooltip = "Fast, sends the poop request directly",
        Callback = function(value)
            state.remotePoop = value
            if value and Library.Toggles.LegitPoopToggle.Value then
                Library.Toggles.LegitPoopToggle:SetValue(false)
            end
        end,
    })

    Box:AddSlider("RemoteDelay", {
        Text = "Remote Delay",
        Default = 1,
        Min = 0.3,
        Max = 5,
        Rounding = 1,
        Suffix = "s",
        Tooltip = "Lower values are faster but riskier",
        Callback = function(value)
            state.remoteDelay = value

    })

    Box:AddDivider("Legit")

    Box:AddToggle("LegitPoopToggle", {
        Text = "Auto Poop (Legit)",
        Default = false,
        Tooltip = "Charges the bar and clicks the minigame like a player",
        Callback = function(value)
            state.legitPoop = value
            if value and Library.Toggles.RemotePoopToggle.Value then
                Library.Toggles.RemotePoopToggle:SetValue(false)

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local StarterGui       = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- {{ toggle }}

local CONFIG = {
    ENABLED = true, -- turn anti off or on (use true or false)
}

local NOTIFY = true -- notify if it succeeded (use true or false)

local function getTorso(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getRoot(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return (hum and hum.RootPart) or char.PrimaryPart
end

local function notify(title, text)

    pcall(function()

        })

end

local function matchesBangFingerprint(plr, myTorso)
    local theirChar = plr.Character
    if not theirChar then return false end

    local theirHRP = theirChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not theirHRP then return false end

    local localOffset = myTorso.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(theirHRP.Position)

    if math.abs(localOffset.X) > 0.25 then return false end
    if math.abs(localOffset.Y) > 0.25 then return false end
    if math.abs(localOffset.Z - 1.1) > 0.25 then return false end

    local dot = theirHRP.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(myTorso.CFrame.LookVector)
    if dot < 0.995 then return false end

    return true
end

local dipBusy = false
local function voidDip()
    if dipBusy then return end
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local root = getRoot(myChar)
    if not root or not root.Parent then return end

    dipBusy = true
    local savedCF = root.CFrame
    local savedDH = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight

    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = -1e9

    local t0 = tick()
    pcall(function()
        while tick() - t0 < 0.15 do
            if not root.Parent then break end
            root.CFrame                  = CFrame.new(0, -800, 0)
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            task.wait()
        end
    end)

    if root.Parent then
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.CFrame                  = savedCF
        local hum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end
    end

    task.wait()
    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = savedDH
    dipBusy = false
end

local confirmCount = {}
local lastAction   = 0

local steppedConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not CONFIG.ENABLED then return end
    if dipBusy then return end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end

                confirmCount[plr] = (confirmCount[plr] or 0) + 1

                    notify("Anti-Bang", "Bang confirmed from " .. plr.Name)

            else
                confirmCount[plr] = 0
            end
        end
    end
end)

end)

    inputConn:Disconnect()
    removeConn:Disconnect()
    charConn:Disconnect()
